name: @waterx/predict-agent-release
description: Release readiness for the workspace: the CycloneDX SBOM of every published package, generated from what is actually installed, and the mechanical preflight that must pass before anything is published. Ships to nobody.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "for (const f of ['preflight','kit','registry','check','bundle','bundle-check','assemble-install','install-check']) require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/src/bin/'+f+'.js',0o755)"
scripts.generate: pnpm run build && node dist/src/generate.js ../../sbom/v1 && node dist/src/generate.js ../../sbom/bundle --bundle
scripts.generate:check: pnpm run build && node dist/src/generate.js ../../sbom/v1 --check && node dist/src/generate.js ../../sbom/bundle --bundle --check
